every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 composes transition frames 4 and 7 with clean, dramatic close-up camera sweeps over the 3D machinery without leaving an awkward half-faded ghost card in frame 7 like Site 1 does.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same clear 3D mechanical factory metaphor across frames 1 through 9—compressing token slabs in the digest press (frame 5), filing content anchors (frame 6), and routing seven host gates (frame 8).

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites share identical well-crafted, grounded 3D machinery with beveled metallic edges, tactile colored blocks, and soft shadows on the dark grid floor across frames 1 to 9, though Site 2 shows off the detail slightly closer in frames 4 and 7.

type_and_layout.reason: While both share the crisp left-hand UI panel in frames 1–3, 5–6, and 8–9, Site 2 avoids the nearly illegible, low-contrast faded card state caught mid-scroll in Site 1's frame 7.

overall.reason: Although both versions share the same clever 3D token-press visualization and layout, Site 2 delivers cleaner scroll choreography and avoids the awkward half-faded text panel seen in Site 1's transition frames.
